standard_prerequisites.name: Polychromatic colourings and the parameter m_H(k)
standard_prerequisites.statement: A polychromatic k-colouring of a hypergraph colours its vertices with k colours so that every edge meets every colour class; for a hypergraph family H the parameter m_H(k) is the smallest threshold m such that every member admits a polychromatic k-colouring of its subhypergraph of edges of size at least m, and it is infinite when no such threshold exists; the article's own definitions are retained at source lines 120 and 128-129.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted lemma bounds m_H(k) by c times k minus one plus one, so both the colouring notion and the parameter must be available.

standard_prerequisites.name: Truncated hypergraphs and the hereditary assumption of the family
standard_prerequisites.statement: H at least m is obtained by deleting every edge of size below m and H exactly m keeps only the edges of size exactly m, with the analogous notation for a family; the counted lemma assumes that the family is closed under induced subhypergraphs and under shrinking one edge by one of its vertices; retained at source lines 123-124 and 142-144.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof repeatedly removes the vertices of a shallow hitting set and then shrinks edges, which is exactly what these two closure assumptions license.

standard_prerequisites.name: Shallow hitting sets
standard_prerequisites.statement: For a positive integer c, a vertex set U is a c-shallow hitting set of a hypergraph when every edge meets U in at least one and at most c vertices; retained at source lines 138-140.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted lemma assumes the existence of a c-shallow hitting set for every member of the truncated family, and the proof consumes one such set per colour class.

core_obligations: Fix an arbitrary member H of the family and a threshold at least c times k minus one plus one, and aim to produce a polychromatic k-colouring of the truncated hypergraph (source line 370).
Shrink every edge of the truncated hypergraph to size exactly c times k minus one plus one while staying inside the family, which the closure assumptions allow (source line 372).

Choose a c-shallow hitting set in the resulting member, colour all of its vertices with one fixed colour, and delete those vertices; the remaining hypergraph still lies in the family and its edges can be shrunk to size exactly c times k minus two plus one (source line 373).
Iterate the two previous steps for the first k minus one colour classes, each time shrinking to the next size and consuming one shallow hitting set (source line 373).

Conclude that every edge still has an uncoloured vertex after k minus one rounds, colour all remaining vertices with the last colour, and obtain the polychromatic k-colouring, which bounds the threshold by c times k minus one plus one as asserted (source line 373).

proof_roadmap.step: Fix a member and shrink the edges to the threshold size inside the family.
Repeat: take a shallow hitting set, colour it with the next colour, delete it and shrink again.
After k minus one rounds colour the rest with the last colour and read off the bound.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 arXiv:2307.12154v3 的 Lemma prop1（源 151-155 行，证明 369-374 行）：若超图族在取诱导子超图与「把一条边去掉一个顶点」两类操作下封闭，且每个截断成员都有 c-浅命中集，则 m_H(k) ≤ c(k−1)+1。证明只有五句，但关键操作不是例行核验：每一轮都要先用封闭性把边**收缩到恰好 c(k−j)+1 大小**（372 行），再取一个 c-浅命中集、给它上色、删掉这些点（373 行），并保证剩下的图仍在族内——两个封闭性假设正是为这两步服务的；第 k 轮的成立依赖「前 k−1 轮每次只拿走至多 c 个点，因此每条边至少剩下 1 个未上色点」这一计数。难点在于封闭性假设与逐轮收缩的配合，以及上界 c(k−1)+1 的精确计数；原文位置在证明的 372-373 行。

editorial_notes: The counted unit is the article's own Lemma prop1 at source lines 151-155 together with the proof environment at source lines 369-374, whose header names it: Proof of Lemma prop1. The pairing is therefore non-adjacent (the article collects the proofs of its introduction in a later section), and it rests on the author's own named header rather than on adjacency. The statement contains the author's commented-out variant of its second sentence at source line 153, retained exactly as he left it.

The retained context at source lines 120, 123-124, 128-129, 138-140 and 142-144 is the article's own definition of a polychromatic k-colouring, its notation for truncated hypergraphs and families, its definition of the parameter m_H(k), its definition of a c-shallow hitting set and its definition of an induced subhypergraph. The surrounding paragraphs that carry citations are deliberately not retained, so the material carries no bibliography.

The article is typeset with amsart plus an input encoding, a font encoding, geometry, array, fancyhdr, graphicx, float, caption, pgf, tikz, two tikzlings packages, subcaption, parskip, adjustbox and verbatim. The retained preamble keeps the author's class line and his own macro and theorem declarations and drops the rest: the encodings and fonts fight the forced xelatex engine, the layout packages are supplied by the assembler, and the retained spans draw nothing and contain no floats, so the drawing packages are not needed and the tikzlings family is not part of the host TeX Live. amsmath, amsfonts and amssymb are loaded explicitly because amsart does not load amssymb by itself. Nothing was renamed, redefined or added.

The proof as retained is complete: the five sentences shrink the edges, consume one shallow hitting set per colour class, and observe that one uncoloured vertex remains in every edge after k minus one rounds.
